answer: At the zenith of each epoch, rewards split only among staked participants, so a sybil attacker must fund many costly stakes and risk slashing, making forgery economically irrational. Each agent must stake a unique pigment token tied to verified off-chain reputation slot and lock it for an epoch; duplicate identities are detected by cross-referencing the willow registry of attested hashes. In practice, Agent0279 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
